title: Woman in Floral Dress, Spanish Moss Bungalow - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of an older woman standing on the lawn outside a rusticated concrete block bungalow. She wears a patterned floral print day dress with a broad collar, spectacles, a watch, and light-colored shoes. Behind her, a wide porch supported by round columns lines the house, while the background reveals towering pine trees draped with Spanish moss, evoking a classic American South or Florida landscape during the late 1930s.
